thread:
hana-kim: Heads-up: rolling out "Consent & Evidence" for Private/VPC installs today in pilot. This adds an explicit legal consent checkbox in the Console and a tamper-evident export for audit requests. Pilot customers only for now. :white_check_mark:

jared-brooks: Nice. What are the admin UX changes?

hana-kim: Admins will see a consent modal when enabling exports. They must confirm network CIDRs and upload an authorized-signature PDF. Exports are tracked with a timestamped operator signature.

security-bot: Security note: exported bundles contain metadata (service configs, package checksums, KMS usage metadata). No private keys or unencrypted secrets are included. Automated PKI chain checks run when certs are present.

jared-brooks: Any CLI for air-gapped customers?

hana-kim: Yes, basic CLI flow for offline bundles:

```
rwctl consent create --admin admin@org.com --cidrs 10.0.0.0/16 --out consent.pdf
rwctl export-evidence --consent consent.pdf --mode offline --out /tmp/evidence.zip
```

se-team: Will update runbooks. Pilot SEs please schedule 1:1 walkthroughs.

legal-ops: Reminder: Legal needs to sign off on the attestation wording before GA.

marketing-ops: We'll have a one-pager and a short FAQ ready for SEs by next week.

deploy-bot: Feature-flag enabled for pilot tenants at 1810001120; rollout targets: us-west-2, eu-west-1. Monitor errors for first 48h.

hana-kim: Thanks everyone. Ping me or @security-bot if anything unclear. :rocket:
